clues.it: Tea era nella 7ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Tea was in the 7th column, in the 1st row and in a different room from Luca.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 2ª riga, accanto a uno scaffale e a nord di Marta.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 2nd row, beside a shelf and north of Marta.

clues.it: Elena era nella 9ª colonna, a nord di Olga e in Plancia.
clues.en: Elena was in the 9th column, north of Olga and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 2ª colonna e nella 4ª riga, ma non era accanto a un salvagente.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 2nd column and in the 4th row, but was not beside a life ring.

clues.it: Luca era esattamente una riga a nord di Marta e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Luca was exactly one row north of Marta and in the Galley.

clues.it: Marta era nella 10ª colonna, accanto a una cassa e a nord di Ugo.
clues.en: Marta was in the 10th column, beside a crate and north of Ugo.

clues.it: Giada era accanto a una pozza e in una stanza diversa da Dario.
clues.en: Giada was beside a puddle and in a different room from Dario.

clues.it: Dario era nella 3ª colonna e in una stanza diversa da Giada.
clues.en: Dario was in the 3rd column and in a different room from Giada.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 12ª colonna, accanto a una sedia e in una stanza diversa da Rosa.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 12th column, beside a chair and in a different room from Rosa.

clues.it: Olga era nella 6ª colonna, nella 10ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Tea.
clues.en: Olga was in the 6th column, in the 10th row and in a different room from Tea.

clues.it: Bruno era in una stanza diversa da Marta e in Cabina.
clues.en: Bruno was in a different room from Marta and in the Cabin.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

steps.it: L'indizio di Tea lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Tea's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 7th.

steps.en: Luca can only be in the 5th row.

steps.en: Dario can only be in the 8th row.

steps.en: Fabio can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 8th, column 3rd.
